''See also: [[Jing Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Naru]] Jing, also known as [[Naru]], is a prominent member of the [[Naru clan]] and a significant figure within the [[Blackflame Empire]]. Recognized as a star of her clan's younger generation, she is married to [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias Arelius]], a union facilitated by her personal interest. Jing possesses the [[Goldsign]] of the [[Path of Grasping Sky]], which is manifested in her shimmering emerald right wing. She also utilizes a prosthetic orange-yellow wing and an artificial eye created by [[Soulsmiths]] from a [[Remnant]]. As a capable combatant, she uses [[wind madra]] to defend against aerial attacks and protect her family. Beyond her martial abilities, she holds a position of importance in clan affairs, serving as a link between her husband and her father, who is a high-ranking official directing imperial defenses.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Naru]] Jing possesses an artificial left eye constructed from a [[Remnant]] and a single wing made of orange-[[yellow madra]] created by [[Soulsmiths]]. Her right wing features an emerald green [[Goldsign]] belonging to the [[Path of Grasping Sky]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Naru]] Jing is the wife of [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]], whom she was being sought by. [[Eithan]] has cleared a path for him to marry her and has spoken to both [[Naru]] Jing and [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]]. Additionally, [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]] intends to follow Jing to the summit of the [[Truegold|Truegolds]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Naru]] Jing utilizes [[wind madra]] in her combat. She is also capable of taking shots at enemies from a distance.}}
